rules.purpose: Inspect source, state, and ownership before editing.
rules.scope: Every repository change or diagnosis task.

rules.purpose: Find the evidenced cause before changing behavior.
rules.scope: Every diagnosis and bug-fix task.

rules.purpose: Use the smallest change that satisfies the requirement safely.
rules.scope: Every implementation task.

rules.purpose: Reuse verified project boundaries and capabilities.
rules.scope: Every design or implementation decision.

rules.purpose: Avoid abstractions for needs that are not present.
rules.scope: Every new helper, framework, interface, factory, or extension point.

rules.purpose: Keep senior design guidance compact: ownership, dependency direction, lifecycle, simplicity, justified patterns, and verification.
rules.scope: Architecture, implementation, review, refactor, and test-seam decisions.

rules.purpose: Require owner, version, license, and rationale for dependency changes.
rules.scope: Every dependency manifest, lockfile, package, or vendor asset change.

rules.purpose: Back completion claims with executable evidence.
rules.scope: Every task handoff and phase completion.

rules.purpose: Review scoped diffs and preserve unrelated user changes.
rules.scope: Every task that creates filesystem or git diffs.

rules.purpose: Label current, recommended, and unsupported claims explicitly.
rules.scope: Documentation, rules, skills, compatibility records, and research claims.

rules.purpose: Do not expose secrets, signing material, PII, or save data.
rules.scope: Source, logs, artifacts, builds, and external tools.

rules.purpose: Follow repository C# style and API naming.
rules.scope: Every C# file created or modified.

rules.purpose: Keep public APIs small and backwards-compatible.
rules.scope: Public/internal C# APIs and package consumers.

rules.purpose: Tie async work to lifecycle and observe failures.
rules.scope: Task, UniTask, coroutine, and callback async code.

rules.purpose: Subscribe and unsubscribe symmetrically.
rules.scope: C# event, UnityEvent, and EventBus bindings.

rules.purpose: Validate trust boundaries and return actionable errors.
rules.scope: Trust boundaries and failure paths in C#.

rules.purpose: Avoid hidden allocations in measured hot paths.
rules.scope: Measured hot paths and allocation-sensitive code.

rules.purpose: Keep config immutable and route mutations through owners.
rules.scope: Config, persistent state, and shared runtime state.

rules.purpose: Keep non-trivial logic unit-testable and add regressions for bugs.
rules.scope: Non-trivial C# logic and bug fixes.

rules.purpose: Use correct Unity lifecycle ownership.
rules.scope: MonoBehaviour, ScriptableObject, and runtime service lifecycle.

rules.purpose: Preserve serialized data during field, type, and asset changes.
rules.scope: Serialized fields, serialized types, assets, and refactors.

rules.purpose: Do not regenerate or edit GUID/meta files blindly.
rules.scope: Unity `.meta` files, GUIDs, and asset references.

rules.purpose: Mutate scenes and prefabs only after hierarchy, overrides, and references are understood.
rules.scope: `.unity`, `.prefab`, hierarchy, override, and reference mutation.

rules.purpose: Keep Runtime assemblies free of UnityEditor and editor assembly references.
rules.scope: Asmdefs, Editor folders, namespaces, and player code.

rules.purpose: Separate ScriptableObject authoring data from runtime mutable state.
rules.scope: ScriptableObject assets, clones, and runtime mutation.

rules.purpose: Track asset load, cache, and release ownership.
rules.scope: Resources, Addressables, Dreamy asset loading, caches, and releases.

rules.purpose: Use update loops and physics queries deliberately.
rules.scope: Per-frame code, fixed-step code, and physics queries.

rules.purpose: Respect runtime UI, input, touch, and safe-area constraints.
rules.scope: Runtime UI, input, touch, and safe-area assets/code.

rules.purpose: Check compile and console evidence after Unity mutations.
rules.scope: Every Unity code or serialized asset mutation.

rules.purpose: Scale EditMode, PlayMode, and build validation to risk.
rules.scope: Unity task acceptance proportional to behavior and release risk.

rules.purpose: Keep feature model, service, and presentation ownership explicit.
rules.scope: Game feature domain, application, and presentation code.

rules.purpose: Despawn through the owner that spawned or rented the object.
rules.scope: Pooled prefab and instance spawn/despawn lifecycle.

rules.purpose: Make currency, rewards, shop, and inventory mutations atomic and auditable.
rules.scope: Economy transactions and persistent reward state.

rules.purpose: Use target-device frame and memory budgets before optimizing.
rules.scope: Android and iOS target-device runtime work.

rules.purpose: Account for sustained load, pause, resume, and background behavior.
rules.scope: Mobile runtime and lifecycle-sensitive systems.

rules.purpose: Keep texture, audio, bundle, and player size budgets visible.
rules.scope: Mobile assets and build size changes.

rules.purpose: Validate Android SDK, JDK, Gradle, IL2CPP, ARM64, AAB, and permissions.
rules.scope: Android build and release settings.

rules.purpose: Validate signing, capabilities, privacy, ATT, min OS, IL2CPP, and Xcode settings.
rules.scope: iOS build and release settings.

rules.purpose: Require baseline, capture, hotspot, change, and comparison for optimization.
rules.scope: Every performance optimization task.

rules.purpose: Require clean CI, versions, store/privacy checks, and rollback plan.
rules.scope: Release candidates and production rollout.

rules.purpose: Keep reusable package code separate from game-specific `_Project` code.
rules.scope: Dreamy package and project ownership decisions.

rules.purpose: Wire services at GameInstaller/bootstrap roots.
rules.scope: Dreamy startup registration and composition code.

rules.purpose: Resolve services at roots or high-level owners, then pass dependencies downward.
rules.scope: ServiceLocator registration and consumers.

rules.purpose: Separate static design config, persistent save data, and ephemeral runtime state.
rules.scope: Dreamy data models and mutations.

rules.purpose: Enforce package manifest and asmdef dependency direction.
rules.scope: Dreamy package dependencies and source references.

rules.purpose: Keep business logic outside concrete UI panels.
rules.scope: Dreamy UI consumers, panels, and items.

rules.purpose: Use Dreamy asset loading with explicit owner/cache/unload decisions.
rules.scope: Dreamy Assets, Addressables, and Resources consumers.

rules.purpose: Use available audio, feedback, and localization packages without invented integration.
rules.scope: Those packages and project integrations.

rules.purpose: Gate API use by installed package version and verified commit.
rules.scope: All Dreamy package API and reference generation.

rules.purpose: Only automate Editor Tools through verified public headless/dry-run contracts.
rules.scope: Codex and CI automation through Dreamy Editor Tools.
